title.text: Flambé Cheese Wheel Truffle Pasta Class & Tiramisù

description.text: Flambé scene with the parmesan wheel! Learn to make fresh pasta, all done by hand. The pasta will be cooked inside an excellent 24 months aged Parmesan with fresh truffle. Learn to make tiramisu as it was once done with the Moka. Wine is Unlimited.

title.text: Negroni Cocktail Experience, Pasta Class, and Unlimited Wine

description.text: Pasta class where you will have a lot of fun! You will learn how to make the famous Florentine cocktail Negroni from a real expert! You will learn how to make fresh pasta like our grandmother used to do. Finally we will eat everything together.
